original_docs: README declares one row per invoice line but does not explicitly specify blank continuation header inheritance. Neither original README nor HARDENING documents that convention.
source_producer: synth.py writes complete carrier, invoice date and total on each invoice row; unchanged original tests consume generated multiline data.
boundary: This repair codifies the existing shipped producer/sample repeated-header format. It does change former silent acceptance of contradictory or omitted continuation headers; no promise of arbitrary undocumented AP-export conventions or new blank-field inference.
